items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021

ctx.x: Have you been able to keep ownership over the years of your own music?

Yeah, yeah, Monk, like I said I was really blessed because I didn’t know anything about the music industry. A good example like when I did the third album, “Expansions,” and the record came out, I mean the record took off real wide. People were calling RCA and all over the world they said we need — so we had a rush back and reprint all kinds of new records and ship them out. And then they called me up and they said, “Lonnie, you’ve got to get a manager right away, you’ve got to” — they said, “you’re on the…
Can you describe how that song got started?
